source: ChatGPT - Assess Reproduction Feasibility, section 2, Người 1 — Shape-Guided PMC
development: 96+87 = 183 original Surface objects. Four-seed development oracle headroom before training.
training: 5-channel 256x256 U-Net, synthetic half-plane occlusion of 20–80%, 40 epochs, BCE + Dice + 0.2 visible retention. Use final epoch.
controlled: Same frozen 128 VG/COCOA confirmation images and same eight raw candidates. Also evaluate first four seeds for source protocol.
prior: S = V union (O intersect threshold(logit >= 0)). RGB inside O outside V replaced with neutral 127. All masks use identical frame.
shape: Maximum full-mask IoU among nonempty candidate masks, seed-order ties and slot 0 fallback.
combined: Equal sum of within-pool midranks of negative prior IoU and frozen Surface loss among mutually valid candidates. Seed-order ties and slot 0 fallback.
primary: Mean selected-mask IoU against pre-occlusion SAM support versus uniform K=8. Unit is image. Source-stratified paired bootstrap, 5000 draws, seed 20261110.
full: Exact 2565 annotated-vocabulary targets with historical matched SAM reference files. Compare progressive Shape and combined transfers to baseline and Surface. Report 204-target cohort separately and historical unseen subset. Same eight seeds each pass and upstream stopping. Shape selects raw RGB; combined applies Surface RGB correction to the jointly selected candidate. Use L40S, report allocation time and GPU difference.
qualitative: Week 8 slide 17 umbrella and bus identified by baseline/Surface object LPIPS; show same source and four method columns.
limits: Controlled pre-occlusion SAM masks are pseudo-labels. The 35% occlusion cohort cannot establish accuracy under heavy real occlusion. Full SAM visible-reference appearance is a different endpoint.
